metadata.title: Parents and Citizens Association
metadata.description: At Fort Street High School, we value strong partnerships with families and the community. Parents and carers can get involved through our Parents and Citizens Association (P&C) or by volunteering at school. Your time and support help make our school a better place for everyone.
